By the harbour in Saltmere

Calm grooming for nervous dogs

One dog at a time, no cages and no rush. We take as long as your dog needs, with breaks for cuddles and a sniff around the garden.

Services

Every groom includes a bath, blow-dry, nail trim and ear clean.

Full groom

Breed-standard or teddy-bear trim, finished with a bandana of your choice.

Bath and tidy

A deep-clean bath and a tidy of the face, feet and bottom between full grooms.

Puppy introduction

A gentle first visit for puppies under six months to meet the clippers and the dryer.

About Quayside

I'm Morgan, and I opened Quayside after ten years in busy salons where dogs waited hours in kennels. Here your dog is the only one in the room.
